items.label: Live captions
items.title: Every word, as it's said
items.description: Open the app, tap the microphone and read along. Each speaker gets their own label, so it's clear who said what.

items.label: Live translation
items.title: Both languages side by side
items.description: When someone speaks another language, they see what was said and its translation at the same time.

items.label: Transcription
items.title: Recordings and files to text
items.description: Save any conversation, or add an audio or video file, and get the full transcript with an AI summary.

languages.title: Captions in the languages your people speak
languages.subtitle: Live captions, translation and transcription in every one of them, including people who switch languages mid-sentence.

awareness.eyebrow: Made for deaf and hard of hearing people
awareness.title: More than words on a screen
awareness.subtitle: Who is talking, where they are and what else is going on: the things that matter when you can't hear the room.

items.title: Knows who is talking
items.description: Save a person's voice once, from about 20 seconds of them talking, and captions show their name instead of "Speaker 2", live and in saved recordings. Voices are made and kept on the phone.

items.title: Shows where the voice is
items.description: Waves at the edge of the screen show which side a voice is coming from, in that speaker's colour, so they know where to look in a busy room.

items.title: Hears the sounds around them
items.description: Sounds show up in the captions the way film subtitles do it. A doorbell, an alarm or a crying baby also makes the phone vibrate.

data.title: How data is handled

items.title: Stored in the EU
items.description: Accounts and saved transcripts are stored in the European Union (Frankfurt).

items.title: Audio is not kept on our servers
items.description: Speech is processed in real time to make the captions. The audio of recordings people save stays on their own phone.

items.title: Never used to train AI
items.description: No content is sold, shared for advertising, or used to train AI models, by us or by any provider we use.

items.title: Every processor is listed
items.description: Our privacy policy names every company that processes data and what for. Transfers outside the UK and EEA are covered by Standard Contractual Clauses.

items.title: A data processing agreement
items.description: We sign one with your organization for paid licenses, when you send us the names or emails of the people to unlock.

items.title: Deletion
items.description: Anyone can delete their account and recordings in the app, at any time.

data.dpa: Ask for the data processing agreement

items.a: An app for iPhone and Android that shows what people say as text, the moment they say it, in 60+ languages. Deaf and hard of hearing people use it in person, wherever they need captions: they open it, tap the microphone and read along. It can also translate, tell speakers apart and call people it knows by name, show where a voice is coming from (iPhone 16 and later), write sounds like a doorbell or an alarm into the captions, and save and summarise what was said.

items.q: Who is Captio AI for Organizations for?
items.a: Any organization that pays for captioning on behalf of deaf and hard of hearing people. Each person gets Captio AI Plus on their own phone for a year, and the organization pays one invoice.
£89, €99 or $109 per person per year for 1 to 19 people, and £69, €79 or $89 per person per year from 20 people. There is no minimum and no setup fee. Prices exclude VAT where it applies.
By invoice and bank transfer. We send a quote first, and we're happy to work with your purchase order process.
Yes. A free 30-day pilot for up to 5 people. Fill in the form on this page and the link to forward arrives by email within a minute. Nothing to pay and nothing to sign.

items.q: Do the people using it need to pay or set anything up?
items.a: No. They open the link you forward, continue with Apple or Google, then download Captio AI for free on iPhone or Android and sign in with the same account. They have the full version straight away. Your IT team doesn't need to install anything.

items.q: What do we see about how it's used?
items.a: Totals only: how many people joined, how many opened Captio AI in the last week, and how many recordings were saved and how long they are. Never what was said, and never who said it.

items.q: How do we add people after we buy?
items.a: With the same link. Once your licenses are active, anyone you send it to can join, up to the number of licenses you have. People from the pilot keep everything they saved.
We send a renewal quote a month before the licenses end. Nothing renews or charges automatically.

items.q: Does it replace a human captioner or note-taker?
items.a: Not in every case. Captio AI gives instant captions wherever the person is, without booking anyone in advance. Where a perfect record is required, many services use it alongside human support.

items.q: Where is our data stored, and who processes it?
items.a: Accounts and saved transcripts are stored in the EU (Frankfurt). Audio is processed in real time and not kept on our servers. Our privacy policy lists every company that processes data. Nothing is used to train AI models.

items.q: Can one person buy Captio AI Plus themselves?
items.a: Yes, inside the app. Organization licenses are for when an organization pays on someone's behalf.
